rules.boundary: Allow unpublished experience proposals only with canonical current-task provenance. Preserve signed capability decisions, mandatory approval floors and content authority.
Allow passive browser state, navigation keys, and syntactically public HTTP(S) navigation; require approval for DOM mutation until provider-attested target semantics and redirect enforcement exist.

Allow passive observation and non-committing navigation such as cursor movement, scrolling, and paging; require approval for clicks, keyboard input, drag, value changes, application lifecycle, and capture lifecycle.
Allow bounded non-delete writes inside the authorized workspace; keep deletion and destination expansion behind approval.
Allow passive terminal observation and a small exact read-only command grammar; require approval for other commands and deny catastrophic destructive patterns.
